statement: For every pair of positive integers u and v, let B_1,B_2,B_3 be independent Bernoulli variables with P(B_i=1)=1-p and set X_{u,v}(p)=1+B_1+uB_2+vB_3. Then p maps to the Shannon entropy H(X_{u,v}(p)) is concave on the full interval [0,1]. More precisely, after exhaustive classification of all subset-sum collisions, each possible entropy profile has second derivative strictly less than zero for every 0<p<1, and its continuous endpoint extension is concave on [0,1].
contribution: A complete elementary resolution of the frozen n=3 layer: all positive-integer collision patterns are reduced to five exact entropy profiles, which share a uniform binary-entropy representation admitting a direct strict second-derivative bound. This makes no claim about the source conjecture for n>3 and no priority claim beyond the documented source comparison.
